subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Event Inside!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our exclusive summer sale event happening this weekend! Enjoy up to 50% off on select items, including summer clothing, accessories, and outdoor gear. Don't miss this opportunity to upgrade your summer wardrobe and gear up for your outdoor adventures. Visit our store or shop online to avail of these limited-time offers. Hurry, the sale ends soon! Best regards, The Sales Team
